_outputDir: DELIBERATELY UNSET — see core/claude-config/mcp-servers.md. playwright-mcp resolves a relative outputDir with path.resolve() against the SERVER's cwd, not against this file's directory, so a relative value here lands wherever Claude Code was launched from. Set it per project with an absolute --output-dir in .mcp.json instead; CLI beats this file, and this file is overwritten on every /webstack update.
